slides.headline: Shoulder rehab stuck at the band stage?
slides.sub: How clinical Pilates can bridge the gap back to full use.

slides.title: Where Pilates fits in shoulder rehab
slides.body: Once the early stage of rehab is under way, Pilates can help build the strength and control your shoulder needs for daily life. It sits alongside your rehab plan, not instead of it.

slides.title: Springs let you load gradually
slides.body: Reformer springs can support part of your arm's weight or add resistance in small steps. That makes it easier to find a level that challenges the shoulder without stirring up a flare-up.

slides.title: Train the shoulder blade too
slides.body: Your shoulder blade is the base your arm works from. Rows, arm work on the reformer and side-lying exercises help the shoulder blade and rotator cuff muscles share the load.

slides.title: Reach overhead, one step at a time
slides.body: Reaching overhead is often the last thing to come back. Your instructor can build range gradually, starting with support and progressing as the shoulder settles and gets stronger.

slides.title: When to get it checked
slides.body: A shoulder that suddenly can't lift after a fall, pain with pins and needles down the arm, or night pain that keeps building is worth reviewing with your physio or GP.

slides.headline: Ready to build your shoulder back up?
slides.body: Our Pilates team starts with an assessment, works within any physio or surgeon guidelines and builds sessions around your shoulder. Book online via the link in bio.

caption:
Shoulder rehab stuck at the resistance band stage?

Bands are a great start, but many people reach a point where the shoulder needs more varied, progressive load to handle everyday life again: hanging washing, lifting bags into the car, reaching for the top shelf.

That's where clinical Pilates can help. Reformer springs can support or challenge your arm in small steps, and the work covers the shoulder blade and rotator cuff as well as the arm itself. If you've had surgery or are seeing a physio, your sessions follow their plan.

Our Pilates team works alongside our physios, so everyone is on the same page. Book online via the link in bio.
